lesson.title: Preparatory tasks
lesson.summary: Test genuinely preparatory work without assuming everything early in a pipeline is exempt.

prerequisites.reason: A preparatory-task label does not bypass the gateway or its decision-influence analysis.

blocks: The **preparatory-task condition** concerns work preparing an assessment relevant to an Annex III use case. Identify the assessment, what the preparation supplies, and what it does not decide.
Preparation is an intended-function question. A component appearing early in a pipeline may still make substantive choices that shape the final result.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3)(d), paragraph 3 gateway and profiling rule

blocks: Fictional Northbridge: a tool arranges already supplied materials into a neutral indexed bundle for a later assessment, without personal evaluation or substantive recommendations. This illustrates a preparation hypothesis.
The gateway, actual decision effects and profiling rule still need evidence. A useful index can be different from a generated suitability score, even if both occur before the final reviewer.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3)(d), paragraph 3 gateway and profiling rule

blocks: Changed fact: the bundle silently omits unfavourably scored applicants. The tool now influences who can be assessed. Calling the omission 'preparation' does not prove it is harmless.
Changed fact: it summarises materials selectively in a way that changes substantive assessment. Record that effect and investigate significance rather than declaring the output neutral.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3)(d), paragraph 3 gateway and profiling rule

blocks: Record inputs, transformation, selection rules, output and downstream reliance. Distinguish purely preparing material from evaluating people or steering outcomes.
The full test remains the no-significant-risk gateway plus a fitting condition and no applicable profiling override. The four conditions are alternatives; their shared gateway is not optional.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Article 6(3)(d), paragraph 3 gateway and profiling rule
